summary: All 8 acceptance criteria are UI-facing (portfolio is static/content-driven; backend exposes only the boilerplate /api/ and /api/status routes, no app-specific endpoints). Covered each criterion with one named browser check; no backend test files were needed. All 8 checks passed.
backend_note: server.py only contains the scaffolded Hello World / StatusCheck routes; no app-specific API surface backs any criterion, so no backend test files were added. `python -m pytest` ran (0 tests) confirming no existing suite regressed.

checks.criterion: Refined scroll reveals animate grouped section content without hiding or delaying access
checks.name: reveal-grouped-sections-visible
checks.evidence: How I Build heading/intro and Exploring heading gain is-revealed class on scroll-into-view; computed opacity settles to 1 and clip-path resolves to inset(0px) after the 560ms transition, with non-empty text content — nothing left clipped or blank.

checks.criterion: How I Build is the primary interactive storytelling moment
checks.name: how-i-build-stage-interaction
checks.evidence: Clicking build-stage-02 sets aria-pressed=true (stage-01 flips false), reveals carry text 'structure, architecture and business rules' at opacity 1, and build-progress-line height becomes 50%; clicking build-stage-04 sets its carry text and progress line to 100%.

checks.criterion: Gap entrance emphasizes the flagship without changing its composition
checks.name: gap-flagship-entrance
checks.evidence: All three real screenshots (Home, Smart recommendation, New task) render with naturalWidth>0 and emergentagent.net src; only the center 'Smart recommendation' slot carries the iphone-prominent class; New Task button click sets aria-pressed=true, confirming continued interactivity with no cropping.

checks.name: project-hover-emphasis
checks.evidence: Hovering the HelpDesk row changes the title's computed color and the learning-dimension label's letter-spacing (before != after); helpdesk-repository-link href resolves to https://github.com/andrefleisch/HelpDesk with target=_blank; smaller project link (other-project-1) shows a distinct transform on hover and its href points to github.com.

checks.name: nav-active-section-feedback
checks.evidence: nav-link-overview starts aria-current=page; clicking nav-link-projects scrolls featured-projects-section into view and flips aria-current to it (overview loses it); clicking nav-link-experience repeats the pattern for experience-section, confirming smooth anchor scroll + marker update.

checks.criterion: One ambient hero interaction remains subtle
checks.name: hero-ambient-pointer-interaction
checks.evidence: Moving the pointer across the hero changes .hero-ambient-line's computed transform between two positions; moving off-hero returns it to 'none'/identity matrix; hero-title bounding box remains unchanged (no layout shift), and no other particle/cursor/glow element was introduced.

checks.criterion: Dark section transitions and existing visual system are preserved
checks.name: dark-section-transitions-preserved
checks.evidence: gap-section and contact-section both carry data-color-section=dark, backgroundImage resolves to 'none' (no gradient), and transitionDuration includes 0.65s (650ms) on both; gap-project-title, contact-title and milestones-title ('More than projects.') remain intact.

checks.name: mobile-and-reduced-motion-accessible
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, tapping build-stage-03 (no hover) sets aria-pressed=true and reveals its carry text; document scrollWidth<=clientWidth (no overflow). With prefers-reduced-motion=reduce, how-i-build-title opacity is immediately 1, <html> carries motion-reduced, document scroll-behavior is 'auto', and its transition-duration collapses to the 0.01ms override.
